parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~98094~~) operation to view information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description:
The ID of the scheduled task to cancel.

> - Call the [DescribeScheduleTasks](~~199648~~) operation to view information about all scheduled tasks for your account, including task IDs.
>
> - You can cancel only tasks that are in the pending state. The `Status` parameter for these tasks returns `pending`.
